review_locator: PMCID:PMC3491449, Interleukin-6, a Major Cytokine in the Central Nervous System
primary_title: Interleukin-6 released in human cerebrospinal fluid following traumatic brain injury may trigger nerve growth factor production in astrocytes
decision_basis: The review identifies IL-6 as an inducer of astrocytic nerve growth factor production in the injured CNS; the cited primary shows IL-6-containing human TBI CSF and recombinant IL-6 induce NGF production in cultured mouse astrocytes, with anti-IL-6 blockade.
limitations_preserved: The measured output is NGF production/release at the protein level; do not infer Ngf transcription, a defined intracellular pathway, or traumatic-SCI transfer from this TBI/astrocyte comparator.
